    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_8/nitride_polymorphs"
